div.div:
• With create root aggregate in the command (or a batch), seven checks do nothing: the four root checks, anonymous versions owned, both hash checks.
• validate_memo_t caches only the three root gate checks. The wizard replaces memo and checker together.
• The wizard's own checks (may_execute_wizard_command) are not in this graph.
